trap_checks_from_the_brief.trap_1_lipids_vs_formulations: CONFIRMED PRESENT. The 16 names on the Fig S2/S3 axes are FORMULATIONS, not lipids: 'Base LNP' plus three Avanti catalogue helper lipids titrated at 10/20/30/40/50 mol% (18:1 TAP = DOTAP, permanently cationic; 18:1 DAP = DODAP, ionizable; 18:1 PA = DOPA, anionic).
